_README: Copy this file to /etc/edge-agent/config.json and edit it for THIS edge box.
It overrides DEFAULT_CONFIG in config.py key-by-key (config.load merges them),
so you only need the keys you want to change - but set every value marked EDIT-ME.
sudo mkdir -p /etc/edge-agent
sudo cp config.example.json /etc/edge-agent/config.json
sudo nano /etc/edge-agent/config.json
sudo chown root:edge-agent /etc/edge-agent/config.json
sudo chmod 640 /etc/edge-agent/config.json
Then validate:  cd /opt/edge-agent/app && python3 preflight.py
--- device_map is the setting that matters most ---
Key format is exactly  "<source_ip>|<syslog_hostname>"  and BOTH parts must match
what the device actually puts on the wire. Anything not listed is silently DISCARDED.
Do not guess these values - discover them:
sudo python3 discover.py --port 514 --duration 600
which prints every talker it hears and writes a ready-to-paste skeleton.
device_id must be globally unique across ALL properties - it is the primary key in
the cloud devices table. Two physical devices sharing one device_id will overwrite
each other's health.
Use "*|hostname" only when a device's source IP genuinely varies (DHCP); a wildcard
accepts that hostname from ANY source IP. config.py's DEFAULT_CONFIG ships six
simulator wildcards (*|switch-floor1, *|switch-floor2, *|router-edge, *|ap-lobby,
*|sensor-hvac-01, *|firewall-dmz). Because config.load merges dicts at the top level,
a device_map you define here REPLACES the default one entirely - which is what you
want, and is how those simulator rows get removed in production.
